description: Multi-stop route optimizer — Offline traveling-salesman route order for up to 40 stops. Give stops= as lat,lon pairs separated by ; plus optional names= (pipe-separated), start= (1-based stop number, default 1), end= (fixed last stop), roundtrip=yes, speed_kmh= (default 70), road_factor= (default 1.3) and service_min= per stop. Returns the optimized order (nearest-neighbor plus 2-opt), legs with km/miles, total vs given-order distance and savings, estimated drive and total hours, and a Google Maps directions link. Price: $0.004 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: logistics_route_optimize
